title: Clinical and neurophysiological effectiveness features of neurorehabilitation in cerebrovascular aphasia
summary: In this study, based on clinical as well as functional diagnostic (EEG) features, the efficacy and characteristics of specific speech therapy for a systematic speech disorder (aphasia) in a usual inpatient neurological rehabilitation will be highlighted. The aim is to identify and weight prognostic factors of specific speech rehabilitative treatment elements.
conditions: Cerebral infarction due to unspecified occlusion or stenosis of cerebral arteries
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
patients with ischemic brain infarction with / without aphasia
Exclusion criteria:
comorbid brain disorders of any etiology
